title: The coming of Buddhism
summary: Follow Mahinda's mission and the Bodhi tree through the Mahavamsa and Dipavamsa.

steps.title: A deer hunt on Missaka mountain
steps.text: King Devanampiya Tissa, hunting on the hill now called Mihintale, meets the monk Mahinda.

steps.title: The Mahamegha garden
steps.text: The king gives the royal park for the Mahavihara monastery.

steps.title: The first stupa
steps.text: Relics are enshrined in the Thuparama.

steps.title: The Bodhi branch lands
steps.text: The branch of the Bodhi tree arrives by sea at Jambukola.

steps.title: Planted at Anuradhapura
steps.text: The Sri Maha Bodhi is planted; saplings go to Jambukola, Tivakka, the Thuparama, Issarasamana, Cetiyapabbata and Kajaragama.

steps.title: Monasteries for new monks
steps.text: Issarasamanarama (Isurumuniya) and Vessagiri are founded.

title: Dutthagamani's campaign
summary: From Mahagama in Ruhuna to the duel with Elara, as told in Mahavamsa 22-32.

steps.title: Born in Mahagama
steps.text: Kakavannatissa and Viharamahadevi's son Gamani is born in Ruhuna.

steps.title: The princess from the sea
steps.text: Viharamahadevi had come ashore at Kirinda, set adrift by her father Kelanitissa.

steps.title: Crossing into Rajarata: Mahiyangana
steps.text: The army overpowers the Damila Chatta at Mahiyangana.

steps.title: Four months at Vijitanagara
steps.text: The hardest siege; the elephant Kandula breaks the gate.

steps.title: The duel at Anuradhapura
steps.text: Dutthagamani kills Elara in single combat and honours his memory.

steps.title: A penance: Mirisaveti
steps.text: Built for a pepper dish eaten without offering it to the sangha.

steps.title: The Brazen Palace
steps.text: A nine-storeyed chapter house for the monks.

steps.title: The Great Thupa
steps.text: The king dies before it is finished, gazing at it from his litter.

title: Journey of the Tooth Relic
summary: Fifteen centuries of the palladium of kingship, from Kalinga to Kandy.

title: The hydraulic civilisation
summary: Tanks and canals from Pandukabhaya to Parakramabahu I.

steps.title: Abhaya Wewa
steps.text: Among the oldest reservoirs in South Asia, attributed to Pandukabhaya.

steps.title: Minneriya
steps.text: One of the sixteen tanks credited to Mahasena.

steps.title: Kala Wewa and the Yoda Ela
steps.text: Dhatusena's great tank and the 87 km canal to Anuradhapura.

steps.title: Kantale (Gangatala)
steps.text: Aggabodhi II's reservoir in the east.

steps.title: Parakrama Samudra
steps.text: "Not one drop of water from the rain to flow into the sea without being made useful."

title: Faxian in Lanka, c. 410 CE
summary: A Chinese monk's eyewitness account of Anuradhapura, read alongside the sites.

steps.title: Arrival in the Land of the Lion
steps.text: After fourteen years abroad, Faxian sails from Tamralipti to Simhala.

steps.title: Abhayagiri: 5,000 monks
steps.text: He lodges at Abhayagiri and sees the jade image of the Buddha; a Chinese silk fan offered by a merchant moves him to tears.

steps.title: The Bodhi tree
steps.text: He describes the Bodhi tree and its veneration.

steps.title: The Tooth festival
steps.text: He describes the procession of the Tooth Relic from the palace to Abhayagiri.

title: Ibn Battuta, 1344
summary: The Moroccan traveller's pilgrimage to Adam's Peak.

steps.title: Landfall at Battala
steps.text: Received by the Aryacakravarti, who controls the pearl coast.

steps.title: The climb to the footprint
steps.text: Up the chains to the summit of Sri Pada.

steps.title: The temple of Dinawar
steps.text: The great Vishnu temple at Devinuwara (Dondra).

steps.title: Galle
steps.text: On to the port of Qali (Galle).

title: The Portuguese century
summary: From first contact to the fall of Colombo.

steps.title: First contact
steps.text: A Portuguese fleet reaches the island.

steps.title: The partition of Kotte
steps.text: The Vijayaba Kollaya splits the kingdom.

steps.title: Mulleriyawa
steps.text: A Sitawaka victory near Colombo.

steps.title: The siege of Colombo
steps.text: Rajasinha I besieges the Portuguese fort.

steps.title: Danture
steps.text: Kandy destroys a Portuguese army.

steps.title: Jaffna annexed
steps.text: Cankili II is deposed.

steps.title: Koneswaram thrown into the sea
steps.text: The temple stones are used for Fort Frederick.

steps.title: Gannoruwa and the Dutch
steps.text: Rajasinha II defeats the Portuguese and allies with the VOC.

steps.title: Colombo falls
steps.text: The Dutch take Colombo after a long siege.

title: Robert Knox's captivity
summary: Nineteen years in the Kandyan kingdom, 1660-1679 (route approximate).

steps.title: Captured at Kottiyar
steps.text: The crew of the Anne is seized near Trincomalee.

steps.title: Held in the Kandyan kingdom
steps.text: Knox lives in villages of the kingdom, observing its society and court.

steps.title: Escape north
steps.text: He and a companion walk north through Nuwarakalaviya.

steps.title: Freedom at Arippu
steps.text: They reach the Dutch fort near Mannar.
